text: Flash! Ready for a test!
Up the stairs -- RUN!
Sit down there! Foot on the red pedal!
Eureka! I did it! You can come out now, Flash --

Let's face it, my friends -- without
a miracle, we've lost.

text: You inhuman fiend!
His Hawkman dropped him. He's dead.
scene_context: Main part of forest, Zarkov speaks to Klytus and Barin about Flash Gordon's fate.

text: You are home.

Shouldn't you fellows be leaving on
your honeymoon?
Earth!
How do we get down to the plasma level?
scene_context: Scene: Climbing up a shaft on Mongo, Zarkov is speaking with Flash, Barin, and Tiger Man about reaching the plasma level.

text: I see you, Munson! Come out or I shoot!
scene_context: Inside a gallery with red sun and red bolts outside; Zarkov is threatening Munson, demanding he come out or be shot.

text: By God, we did it! We made it!
I don't know.
Sit there. When I give you zero, punch that button. Any questions?
scene_context: Scene involving Flash and Zarkov; Zarkov instructs Flash on what to do, specifying an action to take upon receiving a signal.

text: Incredible - the very core of this planet, is it not?
Five, four, three, two, one -- ZERO!
Flash! (NO REPLY) Do you hear me, Flash? Where are you?
Monster!
Extend your hand! That's the gesture of friendship known everywhere!
scene_context: Scene: Unknown location, Zarkov speaks to Flash and Dale as Red Men approach; topic is establishing friendship.

doc_title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES
text: Get out? Why? We're being taken to Ming -- getting at him is our only hope of saving EARTH. It's perfect!
I need your help to take off! Get in or I shot you dead!
scene_context: Zarkov is at a mirror-bright capsule under heavy fire; he is speaking to Dale, demanding assistance to take off or threatening to shoot.

text: In the high grass east of Mingo.
scene_context: Scene with Vultan, Flash, Dale, Barin, Tiger Man, and Zarkov being carried by Hawkmen; Vultan asks about the location of the capsule, and Zarkov responds.

text: Bad. Plasma's contracting into a critical mass. When that needle hits the red, Earth is finished.
scene_context: Scene with WHIRRING ventilators; Zarkov is speaking to Barin about the plasma condition and Earth's impending doom.

text: Some weather huh?
It will get worse.
How did you know?
Friendship...Built this to send to them in...Friendship...The end now...End of the world....Unless we (every sound an effort NOW) Unless...We...Three...Can...

God only knows -- whatever black corner of space this is coming from -- wherever HE is!. -- we'll plunge into the devil's heart and destroy him! We'll die ourselves, of course, but our names will be honored till the end of time!
Devil! Why don't you turn this science to peaceful use? The name Ming would be blessed instead of cursed.
Up the stairs to the tower! Ahead of me -- quick! -- (as they gape at him, FROZEN) Quick I said: We haven't much time -- Earth is being attacked! -- there's only one slim chance of saving it!
Needle trembles on the verge of red.
Cross your fingers, boys!
scene_context: ZARKOV is at a console, protected by VULTAN and TIGER MAN, working on a wiring panel; he speaks to them before hitting a switch.

text:
I can't watch any more. To think of
all our history ended this way --
the incredible ascent from primordial
slime to Albert Einstein and Dale
Arden and --
scene_context: Scene involving Tiger Man and Zarkov; Zarkov speaks near a slot-window, expressing sorrow over the end of human history.

text: Attach the electrodes to the shovels!
scene_context: Mezzanine Control area, during a battle; Zarkov is directing actions involving electrodes and shovels.

text: Pitch them into the plasma!
scene_context: Mezzanine Control area, during a battle; Zarkov is directing actions involving plasma.

text: Hello - we do meet in the strangest places.
But that's impossible! Even your perverted genius can't create new life!
Dale Arden.....
Delighted to see you.
scene_context: Scene: Zarkov meets Flash Gordon and Dale Arden after they are knocked down by a storm; he is speaking to both of them.

text:
Certainly. Just follow me -- up those
stairs.
scene_context: Scene: Zarkov offers to let Flash Gordon and Dale Arden use a phone; he is directing them to follow him.

text: I tell you I can't take it off alone! If you won't come, who will I find?
scene_context: Zarkov speaks to Munson in a side wing, pleading for help as Munson walks away.

text: If you woo't come, who will I find:
scene_context: Zarkov speaks to Munson in a side wing, pleading for help as Munson continues walking away.

text: Heaven knows. I was just starting to test the primary transformer-banks AND ----
scene_context: Scene involving DALE and ZARKOV; ZARKOV is explaining an event that occurred during a test, speaking to DALE.

doc_title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES
text: Klytus can see the future, eh?

doc_title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES
text: Extraordinary. I'd like to study his beta factors -- I wager I could extend them with a course of telekinetic exercise.

text: Tell me -- when you use this fit does your temporal lobe prickle? Here?
What'll you have -- death or dishonor?
scene_context: Scene where Zarkov, still in chains, confronts the confused Vultan; he is speaking directly to Vultan.

text: Basic circuits seem okay.
scene_context: Inside the capsule, Zarkov responds to Dale's question about the functionality of the craft.

text: Jump!!
scene_context: Inside the capsule, Zarkov reacts to a sudden blinding blue light, warning of imminent danger.

text: He has no choice, Dale it's the Mongo way.
scene_context: Scene with Flash, Dale, Barin, Zaakpv, and Tiger Man being escorted by Hawkmen; Zarkov explains Flash's decision to Dale.

text: Fools! Can't you understand? This is no accident-- it's an ATTACK! An attack planned by a MIND! This is ATTACK!
scene_context: Scene: In a room with a TV, Zarkov speaks to the NEWSMAN on the screen; topic is a mysterious event being an intentional attack.

text: Call it what you want, Vultan -- compassion -- mercy: let us teach you the meaning of these words.
scene_context: Scene involving Vultan and Flash; Zarkov speaks to Vultan about compassion and mercy while Flash is holding Barin over an abyss.

text: I predicted it, didn't I?
Ozone layer starting to crack up. By tonight Carbon dioxide will be combining with free nitrogen to form -- (breaks off, crumpling THE SHEET) Well, this is it.
What the hell do I care? I tried to warn him -- he called me mad, like all the others.
Not gone -- Just invisible. See?
scene_context: Scene: Zarkov demonstrates his invisible hands to Dale, showing them picking up and tossing a pebble.

text: Not a bit. I believe Mongo's gravitational. field must have reversed the polarity of my generator so that --
scene_context: Scene: Zarkov explains the scientific cause of his invisible hands to Dale, before being interrupted.

text: Neat trick. I wonder if it's controllable?
scene_context: Scene: Zarkov, after his hands become visible again, comments on the phenomenon in front of Dale.

text: Time for us to go, Munson. Get your toothbrush and whatever.
scene_context: Scene: Inside a tower, Zarkov speaks to Munson after a TV screen explodes, instructing him to prepare to leave.

text: Up. Up and at him.
scene_context: Scene: Inside a tower, Zarkov speaks to Munson, indicating they need to go up, possibly referring to a mission or escape.

text: I can't handle the capsule alone get your toothbrush.
